findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.citation_text:
3-201.11(B) Compliance with Food Law. (B) FOOD prepared in a private home may not be used or offered for human consumption in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT.

This facility is licensed as a Class-III (low risk) facility. The complaint stated that they were serving food prepared at home to customers. This was confirmed by the PIC during this inspection who appeared unaware that this is not allowed. The distinction between a private event and serving to the public was made. Education was conducted and they are instructed to either upgrade their risk classification to Class-II (medium risk) or pull temporary event permits moving forward. In either situation the food would need to be prepared on site. This situation is considered corrected with education to the PIC. The current practice is being ceased at this time.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11 Clean-up of Vomiting and Diarrheal Events. A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

The PIC was unable to provide a procedure during this inspection related to cleaning up vomit/diarrheal events. A copy of the one given out by Sangamon County was given to correct. Another will be sent via email tomorrow. Ensure that all written procedures required by code are maintained at the facility at all times.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

The ice scoop in the ice bin behind the bar is observed with the handle in contact with the ice. Education was conducted with the PIC and the scoop removed to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

At the beginning of the inspection the bar hand sink is observers to be without paper towels. When asked paper towels were provided to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are correctly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

On arrival the ice machine is observed to have black mold growth around the inside of the equipment. The PIC was notified and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. The PIC cleaned the item during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Soda nozzle is observed soiled with brown slime/residue. PIC stated that it was soaked nightly and cleaned once a week. It should be fully cleaned often enough to ensure that it is maintained clean. It was washed during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

1) Numerous flies are observed dead in the ice box of the refrigerator. 2) Several flies are observed flying around in the facility. PIC is instructed to clean the dead ones and use preventative measures to remove the rest from the facility. Fly strips and drain cleaners were discussed but contacting the facility pest control is highly suggested.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

On arrival, test strips were not available for the sanitizer used in the facility. Ensure that test strips are available at all times. Follow up in two weeks for compliance.
